question: A sum of Rs. 7,000 deposited at compound interest becomes triple of itself after 4 years. How much will the amount be after 12 years?
solution:
Given:- 

A sum of ₹7,000 deposited at compound interest

becomes triple of itself after 4 years

Formula used:-

(1) Amount = Principal + Compound Interest 

(2) C.I = P(1 + (R)/(100) )^T 

Where C. I = Compound Interest,

P = Principal

R = Rate

T = Time
